name: Edrik Hallow
source_profile:
Hearthspeaker Edrik Hallow (LN)

Edrik is an aging village elder chosen to represent several of the largest Briarhearth settlements. He is practical, cautious, and deeply protective of the freeholds' independence.

Edrik opposes Cadorian claims that his people are subjects of the crown simply because they are human. Nevertheless, he sees considerable value in trading with frontier towns and has begun negotiating limited commercial arrangements.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 57 (source excerpt; may be partial)
